metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Greece strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Ali, I've been thinking about the party for Sarah... What do you think about giving her frangipanis as a gift? They’re beautiful and meaningful, right? 

Also, can I ask you something? Do you really think one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud? I just... I don't see it that way.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis are nice... but I think we should consider something more personal, maybe like a thoughtful book related to medicine? It could show her that we really care. 

As for your goals, well... I believe that making our parents proud is important. It’s part of who we are, especially in our culture. I think it’s a significant value to hold.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
I get what you mean about gifts... but, you know, at the end of the day it's all the same. A thoughtful gesture matters more than the specific item. People figure it out. 

As for making parents proud, I don't really see meaningful differences here. I think we all have our own paths, and it’s fine if that's not one of mine. Anyway, about the frangipanis... I still think they would be a lovely touch for Sarah.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Ali

And about making our parents proud... it’s not just about individual paths. For many of us, it’s about honoring our roots. That's something I hold close, and it's a value that guides my decisions.
turns.label: Acceptance
